# Search Input

The `Search Input` component provides extra features on top of an <LinkTo kind="Components/Input" story="basic">Input Field</LinkTo>.
See [Input fields guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/input-field/design/)

<Source code="import { SearchInput } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the <LinkTo kind="Components/Input" story="basic">Input Field</LinkTo> component, except adornment props

## Examples

### Dark Mode

<Canvas of={SearchInputStories.Dark} />

Details about implementing dark mode is available in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Visual styles Page</LinkTo>

### Controlled

You can combine `onSearch` and `onChange` callbacks to submit search

- live when typing letters
- only when pressing enter key

<Canvas of={SearchInputStories.Controlled} />

### LargeUntil

This prop will apply `size=large` until the given breakpoint.

- It works only when `size` prop is not passed.

<Canvas of={SearchInputStories.LargeUntil} />

### Sizes

You can set the `size` prop to control the field size:

<Canvas of={SearchInputStories.Sizes} />

### Debounce

Set `debounce` prop value in milliseconds to reduce amount of `onChange` events.

<Canvas of={SearchInputStories.Debounce} />
